title: Actual top-level Compact plain-mark physical context and owned column/granule windows

claim.root_adversary: ROBUST within the qualified plain-mark physical-window target and finite stock fixture
claim.global_goal: ACTIVE; remaining all-types/MV/projection qualification and subsequent <=10% speed goal are not closed
claim.meaning: Curated index to observed commands, root primary-source inspection and actual raw captures. Hashes, field presence and correlated model agreement are not behavioral proof.

risk.boundary: Persistent Compact physical framing, public detached API and shared parser/transport/budget seams
risk.rollback: One exact-path local atomic feature commit; no push, dependency change, history rewrite or unrelated staging.

admitted.api: CompactPartPhysicalContext.open(part_path, budget); read_window(column_name, first_mark, mark_count) returns owned raw shards, not typed .values
physical_profiles: Plain adaptive data.mrk3, one indivisible column slot in exact columns.txt order
Plain adaptive data.mrk4, exact ordered columns_substreams.txt flattened slot roster
laws: Complete 16*N+8 mark records, bounded positive real rows summing to count.txt and explicit physical-EOF/zero-row terminal.
Monotone granule-major/slot-major logical coordinates; equal coordinates and empty child shards remain distinct.
Half-open ends use the next global slot, or next granule slot zero; interpretation is qualified against the observed matching callback roster, not arbitrary serializers.
One consumptive budget across metadata, grid, range index and windows; descriptors charged before proportional allocation, including selected slot clones for zero-mark windows.
Fresh callback-scoped mmap frame index; aggregate touched-frame/output preflight; each touched frame authenticated/decoded once per operation.
Detached columns, roster, granules, shards and bytes; no borrowed mmap slice or retained mutable grid escapes.
Reuse existing private Wide metadata grammar through structural bridges; do not widen existing selected typed admission.

features: Empty Array child domains at marks zero and two; unequal child/outer domains at other marks
Nullable values, duplicate/empty LC strings, both Variant arms and None
fixture.native_settings: Force Compact; uncompressed adaptive marks; LZ4 max_compress_block_size=4096 and min=0; two-row granularity; WITH_TYPES/propagated String version 1, Variant BASIC; mrk3 substream marks off / mrk4 on.

source_contract.relation: Separately pinned comparison source, not asserted executable build provenance or latest upstream.
source_contract.finding: mrk4 roster is a prefix/empty-range bulk/suffix dry-run getter recording unique names in first-seen order; live Compact writes marks per getter event. Generic enumerateStreams order is not lifecycle order. No universal interface callback/roster bijection theorem is asserted.

baseline.observed: Stock Wide/Compact CHECK, schema and literal rows pass. Typed Wide positive; mrk3 rejects missing columns_substreams and mrk4 searches for missing Wide streams. This slice does not relax typed Compact guards.

Parent projection-manifest authentication, native MV SQL/triggers/provenance/freshness, transform/projection composition, general keys/partitions or complete facade decomposition.
Concurrent server mutation, crash durability or untrusted directory ancestry; inherited path-string symlink guards are not component-wise no-follow/access-control.
Whole-file checksum authentication or untouched payload authentication; only touched compressed frames are authenticated.
Total RSS/caller snapshot allocation bounds; fresh header indexing remains whole-file work for each window and offsets are not performance-optimized.
Full repository suite, exhaustive production corruption handling or malicious executable/output authentication; finite report controls do not establish these.
Throughput/memory improvements, cross-version/endianness portability or <=10% speed parity.
